This Sept. 8, 2019, photo shows the stern view of the Golden Ray six hours after the heeling event. Flame and smoke emanate from cargo decks on the starboard side of the vessel. The Marine Accident Report is available at go.usa.gov/xMWcn . (Photo courtesy of the U.S. Coast Guard)
